name: Crews Captains Islanders and Threats — Illustrated

description.value: Captain Mara Cove: will return the lifeboats if the earlier wreck's survivors receive acknowledgment.
Pilot Kai Neutral: can carry treatment through the channel if the forged seal is challenged.
Singer Ren Drift: knows the island's route verse includes unwillingly borrowed names.
Salvager Tessa Basin: holds the rescue boats as security for the captain's unpaid rescue debt.
Surgeon Ivo Quay: can verify the crates before the blockade commander arrives.
Helmswoman Bea Storm: can cut the private anchor if the choir first chooses a safe current.
Keeper Neri Signal: recorded every stranded sailor still waiting beyond the reef.
Commander Sol Flag: will permit neutral transfer under authentic orders and public witnesses.
Chanter Fia Ridge: wants the island's course chosen without permanent ownership.
Sounder Juno Reef: knows a shallow rescue route but needs a repaired lead line.
Quartermaster Mei Crate: can show supplies for both shores despite the forged war claim.
Chartwright Oren Horizon: can write an offered route without copying another sailor's name.
Witness Dev Wreck: survived the earlier capture and wants rescue duties restored to the ledger.
Courier Noa Open: can move the authentic order between ships before the tide turns.
Broker Rosa Anchor: profits from a fixed island berth and hides its risk to the choir.
Rigger Ada Rope: can release chained boats after a witnessed debt settlement.
Porter Pell Shore: will unload treatment on either bank if soldiers stay off the transfer boat.
Sailor Ash Name: heard their name sung into the island course without permission.
Lookout Len Light: can keep the reef signal visible through the coming squall.
Clerk Kira Date: knows the forged blockade seal was signed before the declared conflict.
Diver Taro Chain: can reach the anchor's lower shackle during one calm-water window.
Mate Siva Prize: will revise the ledger if all prize crews share rescue obligations.
Envoy Tess Two: offers inspection by both shores instead of a military escort.
Navigator Eri Verse: can lead a new course using only volunteered names.
Prize Enforcer: locks rescue boats to preserve a profitable capture claim.
Forged Seal Patrol: seizes civilian treatment under an unsigned war extension.
Anchor Warden: holds the island in a current the choir never chose.
Reef Corsair: attacks sounders but may stand down for a share of witnessed rescue work.
Blockade Informer: hides neutral cargo records to force military escort.
Name Harpooner: binds a sailor's name to the island without an offered verse.
Salvage Shark: guards the low-draft route and follows discarded wreck iron.
Quay Gun Crew: prepares to fire on a transfer boat unless authentic orders arrive.
Storm Mouth: swallows fixed routes but opens around a voluntarily chosen current.
Debt Blackmailer: offers boat release only if the earlier survivors stay silent.
False Courier: replaces a lawful transfer order with the harbor's forged copy.
Chart Leech: copies the last route entry and drains the sailor whose name it carries.
Signal Saboteur: quenches the reef light to hide unrescued people from the prize ledger.
Escort Press Gang: forces neutral sailors into service after a cargo inspection.
Island Chain Giant: rises when a private anchor drags across the choir ridge.
Prize Mutineer: tries to preserve capture wealth by abandoning the rescue flotilla.
Seal Echo: repeats the revoked blockade extension through unattended signal flags.
Horizon Broker: sells permanent navigation rights over an island that keeps moving.
